family_a_is_not_a_blind_prespecification: Family A's contrasts were already computed and visible in the committed reports/data/h1_ariana_trough.json before the protocol was written. Family A is an adjusted reading of an existing computation, never a newly prespecified test.
family_b_cannot_isolate_the_representati: A mechanistic arm fits one free parameter on these 47 patients and borrows the rest from the literature; a statistical arm fits a ridge penalty and six to eight coefficients on the same 47. Family B compares transferred structure plus one free parameter against estimation from 47 patients, not representation alone.

free_parameters_fitted_on_this_cohort.HY_poppk_published_plus_ml_residual: 1 structural + the ridge penalty and coefficients of the residual stage, all fitted inside the training fold

how_to_read_the_three_lists: claims_carried: adjusted interval excludes zero AND the improvement reaches the prespecified size. differences_detected_in_favour_of_the_baseline: the adjusted interval excludes zero but the new arm is WORSE, which is a finding about the baseline and not an absence of effect. nothing_detected: the adjusted interval includes zero, which means no difference was detected and never that there is none.
map_be: excluded by construction; one observation per patient
no_clinical_pk_proof: No result here is a clinical-pharmacokinetic proof. It is a comparison of representations on one observed trough concentration in 47 patients from one study.
no_new_model_was_fitted: Every arm is imported from the two frozen runners. This protocol adds a declared family, its Bonferroni adjustment and the statistical-against-mechanistic contrasts, nothing else.
objective: H1 secondary: the three-way statistical ablation and the statistical-against-mechanistic comparison
status_ceiling: exploratory. This cohort has been analysed repeatedly by this project, so nothing here is an independent validation, a new cohort, or evidence transferable to another drug.
target_is: observed pre-dose metoprolol concentration, ng/mL. NOT an AUC, NOT a clearance, NOT a steady-state exposure metric.

the_question_the_note_named.answer: no detectable complementary information; the point estimate is a degradation
the_question_the_note_named.question: Does pharmacogenetics add information the metabolomics does not already carry?

validation.adjustment: Bonferroni across a declared family of 11

bootstrap.unit: patients; a fold repeat is never a second patient

validation.how_identity_is_guaranteed: the fold list is the primary runner's own make_folds, imported rather than reimplemented
validation.why_bonferroni_not_holm: Bonferroni is uniformly more conservative, so an interval excluding zero after Bonferroni would also exclude it after Holm. It also reuses tested code instead of adding an untested adjustment path.
